title: us open day seven 2026 09 05
text:
NEW YORK, Sept 5 (Reuters) - Highlights of the seventh day at the U.S. Open on Saturday (times GMT):
American 14th seed Learner Tien edged Czech 17th seed Jakub Mensik 6-3 1-6 6-7(2) 6-3 6-4 to reach the U.S. Open round of 16 for the ​first time.
German top seed Alexander Zverev, who won his first Grand Slam title at the French ‌Open, beat Alejandro Tabilo 6-2 7-6(2) 6-2.
Kazakh second seed Elena Rybakina defeated Ukraine's Yuliia Starodubtseva 7-6(6) 6-3. The Australian Open champion next faces four-times Grand Slam winner Naomi Osaka.

American Iva Jovic beat Alexandra Eala of the Philippines 7-5 3-6 7-5 in a thrilling battle between two of the sport's most promising young talents. Jovic, the 14th seed, will face Coco Gauff in the last 16.
Japan's ​Naomi Osaka defeated Belgian 23rd seed Elise Mertens 6-3 3-6 7-5 to reach the fourth round.
Fourth seed Gauff beat Spain's Cristina ​Bucsa 6-3 6-4 to reach the fourth round. The 2023 champion's win was a bright spot on a tough day for seeded American players so far.
Six-times Grand ⁠Slam champion Iga Swiatek dug deep to defeat Czech 25th seed Marie Bouzkova 7-6(3) 7-6(3) and reach the fourth round. The eighth-seeded Pole will next face China's Zheng Qinwen, who rallied to beat American Madison Keys 1-6 7-6(3) 7-5 earlier in the day.
Belgian 28th seed Alexander Blockx stunned Italian fifth seed Flavio Cobolli 6-7(4) 6-3 6-0 6-3 to advance to the fourth round, where he will meet Argentina's 24th-seeded ​Francisco Cerundolo.
Cerundolo ​came back from two sets ⁠down to beat American ninth seed Taylor Fritz 3-6 4-6 6-3 6-4 6-4 and reach the fourth round.
French Open champion Mirra Andreeva beat Czech Nikola Bartunkova 6-2 7-6(5) to advance to the ​fourth round at the U.S. Open for the first time. The Russian fifth seed next faces Austria's 24th-seeded ​Anastasia Potapova.
American 10th seed Amanda Anisimova, last year's runner-up, crashed out of the U.S. Open in the third round with a 6-2 7-5 defeat by Potapova.
